policy.ownership: This parsing pipeline adds data indexes, lazy packs, safe source reading and performance optimizations only. Existing Mass, Formation, Prayer, Calendar and Explore pipelines remain editorial/UX owners.
policy.workVsWitness: A document work, a digital witness and an edition-specific passage are distinct IDs; never deduplicate by title or bare short source ID.
policy.permission: Parse and display only original/authorised texts with edition and reproduction-rights approval. Do not infer rights from HTTPS or public availability.
policy.narrative: All opinions must remain attributed to their actual author; cross-links do not imply endorsement.
policy.unresolved: No inline rendering of unresolved source macros, OCR artifacts, inferred chant divisions, or incomplete rituals.
policy.performance: Chunk per chapter/section or content ID; fetch only on user demand; preserve offline and exact return context.
